lines: Five of the ten builders have pushed in their first 45 minutes and all of it is merged and green (416 tests): the cure of the red measure · the icicles · the chimney and its plume · a lift that breaks contact cleanly · a bloom that swells over 20 frames and falls over 7 where it popped in 3
The strokes are 24 mm long now and were 22 (decision 64): the longest at which every pin holds with room
The base still at the final tier shows no broken pixel any more
Round 6 freezes at 20:15 with whatever is pushed by 20:10
phase 3: 11.53 h used of its 11.00 h box
allowance (before the review): 18.15 h used of 36.00 h allowed
